operation_edge.reason:
The UPGRADE compares mavros_msgs u0144 with u0143 and connects mavros mission.py to the generated WaypointGOTO service class. The quoted ServiceProxy construction uses that exact class, so the dependency is concrete rather than a matching string in unrelated packages.

snapshot:s2_work/tasks/u0141/snapshot/mavros/src/mavros/mission.py:135-145
```
def _setup_services():
    global pull, push, clear, set_current, goto

    def _get_proxy(name, type):
        return rospy.ServiceProxy(mavros.get_topic('mission', name), type)

    pull = _get_proxy('pull', WaypointPull)
    push = _get_proxy('push', WaypointPush)
    clear = _get_proxy('clear', WaypointClear)
    set_current = _get_proxy('set_current', WaypointSetCurrent)
    goto = _get_proxy('goto', WaypointGOTO)
```

notes: Substantive service-definition removal. The running snapshot has no WaypointGOTO .srv/.msg/.action and its complete add_service_files list omits it; generate_messages remains in place. The old consumer still names the class in its import and proxy construction. WaypointGOTO denotes a service here despite the generic msg: token prefix; this does not turn the service call into a topic connection.
